first_failure_boundary: G5 used a whole-string orthography admission abstention as a no-target-in-query oracle. A slash-scoped whole-name refusal can still contain an independently certified shorter alias of the same gene.

counterexample.expected_scientific_interpretation: The shorter complete alias can establish the same gene; slash policy on the longer spelling does not negate that evidence.

disposition: Preserve v1 rules/oracle unchanged; no code to revert. Preregister v2 with independently grounded biological reference identities separate from raw spelling lookup eligibility. No candidate outcomes used for revision.
